format:
  revealjs:
    width: 900
    height: 450
revealjs-plugins:
  - magic-move
---

## Slope = 20 {.magic-move}

```{r}
#| label: "before"
#| dev: svg
#| echo: false
library(ggplot2)
mtcars |>
  ggplot(aes(mpg, disp)) +
  geom_point(size = 5) +
  geom_abline(slope = 20, intercept = 0, linewidth = 5, color = "pink") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 16) +
  lims(x = c(10, 35), y = c(100, 500))
```

## Slope = 10 {.magic-move}

```{r}
#| label: "after"
#| dev: svg
#| echo: false
library(ggplot2)
mtcars |>
  ggplot(aes(mpg, disp)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 10, intercept = 0, linewidth = 5, color = "pink") +
  geom_point(size = 5) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 16) +
  lims(x = c(10, 35), y = c(100, 500))
```
